title: 'I am sorry I failed us': Kyler Murray expresses regret after learning Cardinals are letting him go

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: 'I am sorry I failed us': Kyler Murray expresses regret after learning Cardinals are letting him go
sources.description: Upon learning of his imminent release by Arizona, quarterback Kyler Murray expressed regret over being unable to lead the Cardinals to a championship. 'I am sorry I failed us,' he wrote on X.
